confidence_notes: FX is the latest RBA observation found by search, dated 2026-11-18. Food and drink anchors come from scattered web results: a 2024 cafe menu (cappuccino $3, craft beer $3–5), crowd-sourced cost indexes (budget meal $5–10, local beer $2–4, coffee $1.50–2.50) and a travel guide (mid-range meal $20–35). These sources are inconsistent and sometimes undated. No reliable cocktail or wine prices were found, so I set cocktail and wine at roughly 2x and 2.2x the beer price, reflecting the steep tourist drink pricing reported. Accommodation was not searched and is a holistic estimate from general knowledge of a tourist-driven USD-priced market, so it is highly uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Tourist-driven, USD-priced market. Food costs are similar to Livingstone, Zambia, and a bit above Harare, with accommodation priced at a tourist premium.
